Announcing a new Meetup for Big Data & Data Science - Israel!

What: Introduction to R and the Elastic Net
When: Monday, July 8, 2013 5:45 PM

Where: (A location has not been chosen yet.)

 

Abstract

The R statistical programming language is a powerful tool for data analysis. With many features it has a reputation of being difficult to master. To quell these notions we will give a short introduction to R, including reading data and visualization using ggplot2. After that we will take a look at the Elastic Net for regularizing high dimensional data and its implementation in R through the glmnet package.

 

About Jared P. Lander

Jared Lander is the owner of JP Lander Consulting, a New York based data science consulting firm. He is an adjunct professor of Statistics at Columbia University, organizer of the New York Open Statistical Programming meetup (formerly the R meetup) and author of “R for Non-Statisticians” due out in mid August.

 

Jared P. Lander

http://www.jaredlander.com

Check it out!
